dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That trial is something I rarely bring up in conversation, but I've always felt deep regret for what happened to both Carole and Vautrin.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: The words he spoke in court often replay in my mind, as if urging me on to do something...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Wriothesley said he never resented you, right? Isn't that a good thing?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I believe I now understand what he wanted to tell me.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I feel conflicted about those words. How should I describe it... Surprise, relief, fear, and regret... But this blend of emotions has led me to finally understand some things.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I would like to hear your thoughts, too. What do you think of me?
